name: Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice
description: Charred yoghurt-marinated chicken thighs in a rich, smooth tomato, butter and cream sauce with garlic, ginger and warming spices, served with basmati rice.
instructions: Mix the chicken thighs with the Greek yoghurt, 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp mild curry powder, half the grated ginger, 1 crushed garlic clove and ½ tsp salt. Leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes, or refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
Rinse the basmati rice until the water runs mostly clear. Cook the 100 g rice according to the packet instructions, then cover and keep warm.

Heat 1 tsp neutral oil in a frying pan over high heat. Shake excess marinade from the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until well browned and lightly charred. It does not need to be completely cooked through yet. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and melt 15 g butter in the same pan. Add the remaining garlic and ginger and cook for about 30 seconds.
Add 1 tsp garam masala and ½ tsp mild curry powder and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the canned tomatoes, ½ tsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 8-10 minutes until reduced and slightly darkened.
Blend the sauce until completely smooth with an immersion blender, then return it to the pan over low heat.

Stir in the double cream and remaining 10 g butter. Return the chicken and any resting juices to the sauce and simmer gently for 5-7 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre and the sauce is thick and glossy. Add a splash of water if it becomes too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt and sugar if necessary. Serve over the basmati rice and finish with roughly chopped fresh coriander.

Cook the garlic, ginger and spices in 15 g butter, then add the canned tomatoes, sugar and salt and simmer for 8-10 minutes. Blend until completely smooth. Stir in the double cream and remaining butter and bring briefly back to a simmer.
make_ahead.storage: Cool promptly, transfer to a covered container and refrigerate within two hours for up to 48 hours.
day_of: Marinate and char the chicken, then reheat the prepared sauce until steaming. Add the chicken and its resting juices and simmer until the chicken reaches 75°C. Cook the basmati rice fresh and serve with chopped coriander.
